findings: [FRAMEWORK] OnTick starts with QM_KillSwitchCheck at line 241 and omits the current skeleton's QM_FrameworkTrackOpenPositionMae() call before all per-tick guards, so this build cannot emit the required Q08 open-position MAE evidence lifecycle.

[CARD-FIDELITY] The approved volatility gate is H1 ATR(14) multiplied by 24. Lines 102-107 instead prefer native D1 ATR(14) and use H1 ATR times 24 only as a missing-data fallback, producing materially different entry eligibility.

[CARD-FIDELITY] The approved time stop is 96 closed H1 bars and specifies break-even handling. Lines 167-184 convert 96 to wall-clock seconds from POSITION_TIME and close unconditionally at market; weekends and market closures therefore shorten the bar count, and no break-even condition is implemented.

[CARD-SCOPE] The approved card names only EURUSD.DWX, GBPUSD.DWX, USDJPY.DWX and XAUUSD.DWX. The build artifact and set directory contain 13 symbols, adding nine unapproved FX/index hosts; registry consistency does not make that expanded strategy universe card-authorized.
